name: Lucas Santos
tagline: Fullstack engineer with 6+ years shipping production software for travel, legal, agriculture and media companies. I work mostly in React, TypeScript, Node and PostgreSQL, and I care about fast, accessible interfaces.
about:
I grew up playing video games and wanting to know how everything inside the computer worked. By 10 I knew I wanted to work with computers, and I was already writing HTML and my first lines of C++.

The road wasn't a straight line. I taught myself AutoCAD and CorelDRAW and freelanced as a graphic designer, then taught English while working as a freelance IT technician, troubleshooting and supporting my clients' systems. I studied Computer Engineering at UNIPAC and then Computer Science at UFOP, with a lot of C/C++, Qt and Python, plus the React, Node and TypeScript stack I use today.

My first job in tech started on the business side: running the back office for a home-services company's field technicians, doing marketing and cold calls, and launching its first website. I moved into the engineering team there, and since then I've spent over six years shipping production software as a remote engineer for North American companies in travel, legal, agriculture and media.

That mix still shows in how I work: a designer's eye for detail, a teacher's patience for explaining things, and a support tech's habit of finding the real cause of a problem.
